title: 03_functional_difference_matrix
interpretation: Map of BioGears functionality to its fate in the extraction and to the run-for-run result. The inflammation core is translated faithfully (identical output); the cardiovascular control and fluid systems are simplified; and a cluster of vasomotor/fluid/metabolic subsystems (nitric oxide, fever vasodilation, renal/urine, lactate, intracellular water, respiration, nutrition) is omitted or inert — exactly the pathways that would couple into SVR, CO and volume, which is where every divergence lands.
